create_XNNPACKQuantizer: create an XNNPACKQuantizer instance and set global quantization config for static quantization
build_symmetric_quant_config: build a symmetric quantization configuration with per-channel weights and QAT support

set_module_type_config: set quantization config for specific module types like nn.Conv2d or nn.Linear
get_supported_operators: get the list of supported operator patterns for XNNPACK quantization
